arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib,tempfile,shutil,hashlib,subprocess,sys,os
from pathlib import Path
repo='martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex'
branch='fix/rea-exact-path-cli-scoping-20261030'
head='77bf74f15ff306823b6bfdf75f6b0ff2261f1b05'
expected={'codex/scope_discovery.py':'96646fe4f502f2fafda6ecdc07b9fbeb2619fc13d39aba9affa7f8c5ca4fb270',
          'codex/tests/test_scope_discovery.py':'446ad8a57e607dfa265223796454d754d6ca36a80dc4dec4b1ce8ab94c8569c5'}
tmp=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='rea-plcodex-pr46-readback-',dir='/tmp'));tmp.chmod(0o700)
try:
 src=tmp/'repo'
 subprocess.run(['git','clone','--quiet','--depth','4','--branch',branch,'https://github.com/'+repo+'.git',str(src)],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=85)
 actual=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'rev-parse','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.strip()
 assert actual==head,'PR_HEAD_SHA_DRIFT'
 print('PR_HEAD_VERIFIED',actual,flush=True)
 for path,digest in expected.items():
  data=(src/path).read_bytes()
  got=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
  assert got==digest,'PR_FILE_CONTENT_DIFFERS_FROM_REA_TESTED '+path
  print('REA_TESTED_BLOB_VERIFIED',path,got,flush=True)
 p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','unittest','codex.tests.test_scope_discovery','-q'],cwd=src,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=50,env={**os.environ,'PYTHONPATH':str(src)})
 summary=' | '.join(x.strip() for x in p.stderr.splitlines() if x.strip().startswith('Ran ') or x.strip()=='OK' or x.strip().startswith('FAILED '))
 print('FOCUSED_PR_TEST_EXIT',p.returncode,'SUMMARY',summary,flush=True)
 if p.returncode:raise RuntimeError('FOCUSED_PR_TEST_FAIL '+p.stderr[-1200:])
 diff=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'diff','--check','HEAD^','HEAD'],capture_output=True,text=True)
 assert diff.returncode==0,'DIFF_CHECK_FAIL '+diff.stderr
 status=subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(src),'status','--porcelain'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True)
 assert not status.stdout.strip(),'CLONE_MUTATED'
 print('REA_PUBLISHED_BRANCH_SHA256_AND_FOCUSED_TEST_PASS',flush=True)
finally:
 shutil.rmtree(tmp)
 print('REA_PRIVATE_CLONE_CLEANED',flush=True)
PY
